title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Steelers D/ST racks up eight sacks Sunday
items.desc: The Steelers defense allowed six points on 319 total yards with eight sacks and two fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Browns.
items.impact: The Steelers pass rush made it tough on Deshaun Watson all afternoon with eight sacks. The lone struggle for Pittsburgh on the day came via containing Harold Fannin. The Steelers head into their bye next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Boswell connects on 5-of-6 kicks Sunday
items.desc: Chris Boswell made 2-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Boswell made field goals from 20 and 37 yards out. His miss came from 57 yards out. He remains one of the more consistent kickers for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darnell Washington turns in big gain Sunday
items.desc: Darnell Washington caught 3-of-5 targets for 94 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Washington found himself wide open for a catch and run of 58 yards. He has his flashes, but he still remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Freiermuth scores touchdown on ground Sunday
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-2 targets for 35 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Freiermuth scored a touchdown at the goal line on a tush push. His upside remains limited as a pass catcher. He is a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Germie Bernard catches five passes Sunday
items.desc: Germie Bernard caught 5-of-5 targets for 30 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Bernard hauled in all five targets that went his way. He remains in the WR3/WR4 range for fantasy managers while Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson both remain sidelined.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Kevin Coleman Jr. grabs late touchdown in loss to Pats
items.desc: Kevin Coleman Jr. caught all three of his targets for 46 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
items.impact: Coleman now has a touchdown in two of his last three games, those touchdowns being sandwiched around a game with only one target and no catches. He's a name to watch in this passing attack as a deep threat, but not one you should add or start just yet.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf drops pass that leads to interception Sunday
items.desc: DK Metcalf caught 1-of-6 targets for four yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Metcalf dropped an open pass that was going for over 30 yards. He not only dropped the pass, but the ball also bounced off him and resulted in an interception. He is an upside WR3 with a low floor for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Dowdle saw a fairly decent role behind Jaylen Warren in Sunday's win. He'll be on the RB3 radar moving forward if his current role holds.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Chris Bell hauls in four passes in loss to New England
items.desc: Chris Bell caught four of five targets for 31 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
items.impact: Bell now has back-to-back games with 3+ catches and 25+ receiving yards, hinting that he's not only becoming more involved but healthier and more up to speed. The rookie was always going to have to take some time to get over the ACL tear he sustained in his final year of college, and we might be watching the beginnings of a breakout.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Warren runs for 143 yards Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Warren ran for 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Warren did not catch either of his two targets. He tied his career-high in rushing despite Rico Dowdle seeing 15 carries himself. Warren remains a borderline RB1/RB2 heading into the Steelers bye week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Greg Dulcich snags four passes in loss to Pats
items.desc: Greg Dulcich caught four of six targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Funny enough, he had the exact same receiving line as Caleb Douglas, who also had four receptions on six targets for 43 yards. Not only that, but just to mention it for fun, the game's total was 43 points, and the average receiving yards of Miami's top four receivers in this game was 43. Do with that information what you choose, but either way, Dulcich has been on the rise recently, with 5+ targets and 37+ receiving yards in each of the last three games. Not only that, but next week he gets the Lions, who have been one of the best matchups for tight ends so far this year.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Rodgers throws for 172 yards Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers completed 13-of-25 passes for 172 yards with an interception in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Rodgers did not need to do much in Sunday's win as the ground game dominated for Pittsburgh. He had one big throw to Darnell Washington that went for 58 yards. His interception was on a dropped pass by D.K. Metcalf. The Steelers are on their bye next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Browns D/ST struggles against run Sunday
items.desc: The Browns defense allowed 27 points on 361 total yards with one sack and one interception on Sunday against the Steelers.
items.impact: Jaylen Warren and Rico Dowdle combined to run for 199 yards on Sunday. Cleveland will face Tyler Shough and the Saints next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andre Szmyt makes two field goals Sunday
items.desc: Andre Szmyt went 2-for-2 on field goals on Sunday.
items.impact: Szmyt connected on attempts from 32 and 49 yards out. Those were the lone points scored by Cleveland on the day.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Caleb Douglas comes down to earth in loss
items.desc: Caleb Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
items.impact: Douglas came back down to earth on Sunday, though a four for 43 yards is just fine in real life for a rookie. His efficiency had been insane, so it was bound to come down at some point. He's going to have a better matchup next week against the Lions and could be a flex play in that spot.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. explodes for 154 yards Sunday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. caught 10-of-12 targets for 154 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Fannin was the lone bright spot on the day offensively for Cleveland. He set career-highs in both catches and yards. He remains a TE1 heading into next week against the Saints.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Malik Washington snags touchdown in loss to Patriots
items.desc: Malik Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
items.impact: Washington had a score in the second quarter to put the Dolphins up by 10, led the team in receptions, and tied for the lead in targets. He's developed into a usable PPR asset this season and should have some utility next week against the Lions' secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jerry Jeudy held without catch Sunday
items.desc: Jerry Jeudy did not catch his lone target in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Jeudy remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Denzel Boston hauls in six passes Sunday
items.desc: Denzel Boston caught 6-of-11 targets for 37 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Boston was second only behind Harold Fannin on the team in targets. He was unable to turn any of them into big gains. He remains on the WR3/WR4 radar for fantasy managers as a volatile week-to-week play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. totals 37 yards Sunday
items.desc: KC Concepcion Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 37 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Concepcion was quiet compared to last week when he exploded for 129 yards. He'll remain a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ollie Gordon II runs for 69 yards in loss
items.desc: Ollie Gordon II ran 19 times for 69 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He also failed to catch his only target.
items.impact: After four straight weeks with a rushing touchdown and three straight weeks of 88+ rushing yards, Gordon finally had himself a down game. That's to be expected for a player who has almost zero passing game involvement; the floor falls out when receiving is nil. He will face off against the Lions next weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dylan Sampson catches six passes Sunday
items.desc: Dylan Sampson ran for seven yards on one carry in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 6-of-8 targets for 62 yards receiving.
items.impact: Sampson has now caught 9-of-11 targets across two games since returning from injury. He remains on the flex radar in PPR leagues for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinshon Judkins shut down on ground Sunday
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins ran for 25 yards on 11 carries in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 24 yards receiving.
items.impact: Judkins was completely stifled on the ground all afternoon. He will look to bounce back as an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Malik Willis tosses two touchdowns in loss to Patriots
items.desc: Malik Willis completed 21-of-32 passes for 211 yards with two touchdowns and a pick in the Dolphins' 24-19 win over the Patriots. He ran once for two yards.
items.impact: Willis now has six passing touchdowns to five interceptions on the season, and his season-high in passing yardage is 220 yards, set back in Week 1. The rushing upside is there; we've seen it each of the two weeks prior to this one, but in games like Sunday's, it completely evaporates. He's usable as a QB2, but the hope for a modest passing season with prolific rushing numbers is seeming unlikely.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deshaun Watson throws for 324 yards Sunday
items.desc: Deshaun Watson completed 27-of-39 passes for 324 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Watson did not throw a touchdown or interception, but he did lose a fumble. He was also sacked eight times. Watson will be a QB2 play next week against the Saints.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Buccaneers D/ST records four interceptions Sunday
items.desc: The Buccaneers defense pitched a shutout on Sunday against the Falcons, allowing 224 total yards with four interceptions.
items.impact: It was a nightmare of a day for Michael Penix Jr. in bad weather against the Tampa Bay defense. The Bucs will face a tougher test against Caleb Williams and the Bears next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin connects on three field goals Sunday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt on Sunday.
items.impact: Despite brutal weather, it didn't stop McLaughlin from hitting field goals from 46, 34 and 42 yards out in the first half. He remains one of the top kickers in fantasy football this season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: New England Patriots D/ST rack up five sacks in win
items.desc: The New England Patriots D/ST racked up five sacks and a pick in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.impact: The Patriots' defense struggled a bit in the first half before tightening up on the Dolphins in the second half, holding them to just six points while the offense got back on their feet. They will face a tougher matchup next week against Green Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Otton does not see target Sunday
items.desc: Cade Otton was not targeted in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Baker Mayfield attempted only three passes on Sunday and he did not complete any of them. Otton will be a TE2 play next week against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tez Johnson does not see target Sunday
items.desc: Tez Johnson did not see a target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Baker Mayfield attempted just three passes and did not complete any of them on Sunday. Johnson remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ted Hurst III does not catch pass Sunday
items.desc: Ted Hurst III did not catch his lone target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass on Sunday. Hurst will remain off the fantasy radar when Emeka Egbuka is healthy.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Bengals D/ST allows 36 points in Week 8
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed 36 points while picking up two sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
items.impact: Cincinnati's defense did not play well against the middling Tennessee offense. They did manage to recover two fumbles but overall it was a disappointing outing for the Bengals on defense. They will look to bounce back against the Falcons in Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. does not catch pass Sunday
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. did not catch his lone target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass in the win on Sunday. Godwin has struggled all season regardless of the circumstances. He'll be a WR4/WR5 moving forward.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Evan McPherson makes five XPs in Week 8
items.desc: Evan McPherson made all five of his extra points in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
items.impact: McPherson did not attempt any field goals in the high-scoring win. The veteran kicker has now converted all 10 of his field-goal attempts and added 24 extra points on the season. He will take on the Falcons in Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell sees 25 carries Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell ran for 140 yards on 25 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Gainwell and Bucky Irving combined for 310 rushing yards on 52 carries on a day where Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. He'll be an RB3/RB4 play next week against the Bears.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Andy Borregales has six kicking points in win
items.desc: Andy Borregales made all three of his PATs and one of his two field goal attempts in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Borregales could have had a little bit better game if he had made that other field goal attempt, but a win is a win. He's not been the hottest kicker out there, but he's had 6+ kicking points in six of eight games this season.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jack Endries finds the end zone in Week 8
items.desc: Jack Endries caught his lone target for a one-yard touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
items.impact: Endries made his first NFL catch count as he hauled in a touchdown pass from Joe Burrow in the second quarter. The rookie tight end should see more playing time with Erick All landing on injured reserve after tearing his ACL in Week 7.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving explodes for 170 yards Sunday
items.desc: Bucky Irving ran for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: It was the Irving and Kenneth Gainwell show all afternoon as Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. Irving saw career-highs in both carries and yardage. He also had a second touchdown taken away on a fumble at the goal line. He'll be a borderline RB1 play next week against the Bears.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Mike Gesicki catches TD in Week 8
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught four of his six targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
items.impact: Gesicki had a big afternoon in the Bengals' first game since losing Erick All to a torn ACL. He has now caught a touchdown in all six of his games played this season. Gesicki will be a high-end TE2 in Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Eli Raridon quiet in win over Dolphins
items.desc: Eli Raridon caught one of four targets for five yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.impact: Not counting throwaways, Raridon was the intended target on all of Drake Maye's incompletions on Sunday. Do with that what you will, but either way, it was not the best game for the rookie. He will have better days, and on the bright side, this means he has had 4+ targets in three of his last four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield does not complete pass Sunday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield went 0-for-3 in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: The Bucs managed to win a game where Mayfield did not complete a single pass as they ran for 324 yards as a team. This was the second time a team has completed zero passes in the Super Bowl era and the first time in over 50 years. Mayfield will be a QB2 play next week against the Bears.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Dohnte Meyers goes for 34 yards in Week 8
items.desc: Dohnte Meyers caught all three of his targets for 34 yards in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
items.impact: Meyers had a solid afternoon as the Bengals' No. 3 receiver. While he won't see much work stuck behind Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, Meyers has shown that he has enough talent to earn a role in the NFL. He will now prepare to face the Falcons in Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Folk misses lone attempt Sunday
items.desc: Nick Folk missed his lone field goal attempt on Sunday.
items.impact: Folk missed from 53 yards out on the opening possession of the game. It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Falcons D/ST gets run over Sunday
items.desc: The Falcons D/ST allowed 16 points on 322 total yards with one sack and one fumble recovery against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Atlanta managed to lose a game where Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass as the Bucs ran for 324 yards on the ground. They'll remain off the fantasy radar next week against the Bengals.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Efton Chism III snags five passes in win
items.desc: Efton Chism III caught all five of his targets for 37 yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Chism led the Patriots in targets and receptions in this game, posting a modest 37-yard total as a result. He could be back in as a sneaky PPR flex should AJ Brown continue to miss time, but his floor and ceiling seem to be fairly low at this point in time.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tee Higgins scores twice in Week 8 win
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 10 of his 11 targets for 155 yards and two touchdowns in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
items.impact: Higgins had a huge game in the high-scoring win. He hauled in touchdown passes of 17 and 18 yards from Joe Burrow, giving him four on the season. Higgins has been on fire of late, reaching at least 148 receiving yards in three of his past four games. He will be a WR1 in Week 9 vs. Atlanta.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. quiet Sunday
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. He will remain a TE2 play next week against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jahan Dotson hauls in 76 yard pass Sunday
items.desc: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-5 targsts for 95 yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Dotson had a 76-yard reception with the Falcons recording 224 total yards of offense as a team. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase goes for 141 yards, TD in Week 8 win
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 of his 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
items.impact: Chase turned in a huge game in the high-scoring win, although he still finished behind Tee Higgins in receiving yardage on an afternoon where Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards. Chase has scored a touchdown in three straight games, giving him six overall this year. He will be a no-brainer WR1 in fantasy heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drake London catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Drake London caught 1-of-6 targets for eight yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense as Michael Penix Jr. completed just eight passes all day and threw four interceptions. London remains a WR1 play next week against the Bengals.
